title: .kimera.yml
description: Kimera mutation testing configuration. Every key also has a command-line flag; flags win.

paths.description: Source files to mutate: globs, directories or files (default: app/**/*.rb, lib/**/*.rb).

tests.description: Test files to load; each mutant runs only the tests that cover it (default: spec/**/*_spec.rb).

exclude_tests.description: Test files to leave out, e.g. system tests that need a browser.

operators.description: Operator keys, or the groups all, rails and custom (default: the conservative core).

require.description: Ruby files loaded before the scan, for custom operators.

isolate_when_covered_by.description: Judge in a fresh process every mutant a test whose id contains one of these covers.

soft_timeout.description: Seconds each covering test may run under a mutant before it is interrupted (default: 5).

hard_timeout.description: Seconds before the watchdog kills a worker stuck in one test (default: soft_timeout x 3 + 1).

relative_timeout.description: Count a mutant as a timeout when a covering test runs far past its baseline time (default: true).

timeout_factor.description: Relative timeout: multiple of the test's baseline time (default: 10).

timeout_slack.description: Relative timeout: seconds added to the multiple (default: 1).

leak_every.description: Re-check every Nth kill for state leaked between tests (default: 10).

jobs.description: Parallel workers. Use 1 when tests share a directory, file or port (default: 1).

coverage.description: Run each mutant only against the tests that cover it (default: true).

isolate_db.description: Wrap each mutant in a rolled-back ActiveRecord transaction (default: false).

rejudge.description: Judge again in a fresh process what the warm pass could not (default: true).

max_survivors.description: Gate: fail when more mutants than this survive (default: 0).

max_ignored.description: Gate: fail when more mutants than this are ignore-listed. Raise it in the diff that adds the entry it admits.

max_errors.description: Gate: fail when more mutants than this could not be judged (default: 0).

fail_on_no_coverage.description: Gate: also fail when a mutant in scope has no covering test (default: false; kimera ci turns it on).

baseline.description: YAML file of survivors accepted when adopting Kimera, from kimera baseline create.

report.description: Where to write the JSON report (default: tmp/kimera/report.json), or false for none.

log.description: Also write the text report to this file.

color.description: Color the text report (default: when stdout is a terminal, unless NO_COLOR is set).

verbose.description: Print the resolved scope and settings (default: false).

ignore.description: Known-equivalent mutants. An entry matches the mutants every anchor it lists matches; each needs a reason.

file.description: Glob of the file the mutant is in.

reason.description: Why no test can tell the mutant from the original. Name the mechanism.

line.description: A line the mutated code spans.

starts.description: The line the mutated code starts on.

column.description: The 0-based column the mutated code starts at.

original.description: The original code, compared ignoring whitespace.

operator.description: Operator key, or a list of them.
